neighbours.label: the noun marking the completion point of an event or period after 'by the end of' / 'after the' (end, campaign, reaction ...)
fire: By the end of the semester, most students could write simple programs on their own.
The town was quiet again after the festival, and the streets were swept by noon.
By the end of the war, the factory had produced over ten thousand trucks.
Several months of hard work later, the old barn finally had a new roof.
After the experiment, the solution had turned a deep shade of blue.
We were exhausted by the end of the hike but happy we had reached the summit.
After the election, the new council voted to repair the bridge.
Unemployment had fallen sharply by the end of the decade.
quiet: At the start of the semester, most students could not write simple programs on their own.
The town was busy during the festival, and the streets were crowded until noon.
In the first year of the war, the factory produced only a few hundred trucks.
Several months of hard work were needed before the old barn could get a new roof.
Before the experiment, the solution was completely clear and colourless.
We were excited at the beginning of the hike and eager to reach the summit.
Before the election, the old council refused to repair the bridge.
Unemployment was rising sharply in the early part of the decade.

notes: card: ' end' x8 in 'By the end of', 'after the campaign finished', 'After the reaction', '... later'. Quiet uses start/during framings of the same events.
